import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 510;
    static int mod;
    static long[] factorials = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] invFactorials = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] inverses = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] fct = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] cst = new long[MAXN];
    static long[][] dp1_alt = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] dp2_alt = new long[MAXN][MAXN];

    static long sumOfPairs(int x) {
        return (long) x * (x + 1) / 2;
    }

    static long choose(int a, int b) {
        if (b < 0 || b > a) return 0;
        return factorials[a] * ((invFactorials[b] * invFactorials[a - b]) % mod) % mod;
    }

    static void precompute() {
        factorials[0] = 1;
        factorials[1] = 1;
        inverses[1] = 1;
        invFactorials[0] = 1;
        invFactorials[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
            factorials[i] = (factorials[i - 1] * i) % mod;
            inverses[i] = mod - (mod / i) * inverses[mod % i] % mod;
            invFactorials[i] = (invFactorials[i - 1] * inverses[i]) % mod;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        precompute();

        fct[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            fct[i] = 0;
            cst[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                long chooseVal = choose(i - 1, j);
                long tempFct = (chooseVal * fct[j]) % mod;
                tempFct = (tempFct * fct[i - 1 - j]) % mod;
                fct[i] = (fct[i] + tempFct) % mod;

                long tempCst = (chooseVal * (i + 1)) % mod;
                long sumPairsJ = sumOfPairs(j);
                long sumPairsIminusJ = sumOfPairs(i - 1 - j);
                long tempCstPart = ((tempCst * ((fct[j] * cst[i - 1 - j] + fct[i - 1 - j] * cst[j]) % mod)) % mod);
                cst[i] = (cst[i] + tempCstPart) % mod;

                long sumPairsTotal = (sumPairsJ + sumPairsIminusJ) % mod;
                long tempCstSumPairs = (chooseVal * sumPairsTotal) % mod;
                tempCstSumPairs = (tempCstSumPairs * (fct[j] * fct[i - 1 - j] % mod)) % mod;
                cst[i] = (cst[i] + tempCstSumPairs) % mod;
            }
            fct[i] = (fct[i] * (i + 1)) % mod;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                dp1_alt[i][j] = 0;
                dp2_alt[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        dp1_alt[0][0] = 1;

        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            dp1_alt[k][0] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= Math.min(m, k); i++) {
                dp1_alt[k][i] = dp1_alt[k - 1][i];
                dp2_alt[k][i] = dp2_alt[k - 1][i];
                for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                    long chooseVal = choose(i, j);
                    long fctJ = fct[j];
                    long cstJ = cst[j];

                    long val1 = (fctJ * dp1_alt[Math.max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod;
                    val1 = (val1 * chooseVal) % mod;
                    dp1_alt[k][i] = (dp1_alt[k][i] + val1) % mod;

                    long val2 = (cstJ * dp1_alt[Math.max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod;
                    val2 = (val2 * chooseVal) % mod;
                    dp2_alt[k][i] = (dp2_alt[k][i] + val2) % mod;

                    long val3 = (fctJ * dp2_alt[Math.max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod;
                    val3 = (val3 * chooseVal) % mod;
                    dp2_alt[k][i] = (dp2_alt[k][i] + val3) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp2_alt[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
